pages.description: SANDLÖPARE soft toy, hippopotamus/grey, 56 cm Just like a real hippopotamus, this soft toy has a wonderfully chubby body and sturdy, strong legs. Soft and nice, it’s ready for many endless hugs and cosy moments. Great to combine with other items in the SANDLÖPARE collection.
pages.ld_description: SANDLÖPARE Soft toy - hippopotamus/grey 56 cm. Did you know that hippos love water – but can't swim? This little soft friend can also handle a splash of water, but feels best in your child's warm, safe (and dry!) embrace. Great to combine with other items in the SANDLÖPARE collection.
